installerFixes.bug: next_id listed UniqueID on /Groups, but group records carry PrimaryGroupID — the empty result produced user/group records with no GID, so id() failed and the script aborted
installerFixes.fix: next_id takes the id attribute per collection (UniqueID for /Users, PrimaryGroupID for /Groups) and always emits a number

installerFixes.bug: DSH_SSH_BROKER_NODE pointed into /Users/m2/.nvm; the privacy framework denies system daemons exec inside any user home (launchd: access(X_OK) EACCES -> exit EX_CONFIG), so the broker never started
installerFixes.fix: node copied to /usr/local/opt/dsh-broker/bin/node; the install.sh header now documents that DSH_SSH_BROKER_NODE must resolve outside /Users/*
